scripts.build: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, VITE_API_URL: process.env.VITE_API_URL || 'https://narcos-shop.onrender.com/api' }; const npmCmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const run = (args, customEnv = process.env) => { const result = spawnSync(npmCmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit', env: customEnv }); if ((result.status ?? 1) !== 0) process.exit(result.status ?? 1); }; run(['run', 'build', '--workspace', 'frontend'], env); run(['run', 'build', '--workspace', 'backend']); run(['run', 'build', '--workspace', 'bot']);"
scripts.postinstall: [ "$RENDER" = true ] && npm run build --workspace backend || true
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace bot
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.verify: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run test && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, VITE_API_URL: process.env.VITE_API_URL || 'https://narcos-shop.onrender.com/api' }; const npmCmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const result = spawnSync(npmCmd, ['run', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit', env }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
